overview.about: The Lotte Championship is the LPGA's stop in Hawaii, played amid the trade winds and ocean views of Oahu. The island setting and breezy conditions make it one of the most scenic and enjoyable weeks on the schedule.
overview.nextEvent: The next Lotte Championship is played at Hoakalei Country Club in Ewa Beach, Hawaii. Ocean breezes off the Pacific are the main challenge on the resort layout.
